name: Lactic acid

lead: Lactic acid is an alpha hydroxy acid used in exfoliating serums, peels and body lotions. It is often chosen by people with sensitive skin because it is typically milder than glycolic acid.
It has been studied for hyperpigmentation and photoaged skin, and it also contributes to natural moisturizing factor in the skin.

paras: Lactic acid loosens connections between dead skin cells to promote exfoliation, and it also acts as a humectant that supports hydration. Larger molecular size than glycolic acid limits penetration depth.
Irritation, stinging and increased sun sensitivity occur, and professional-strength peels carry a risk of pigment changes. Sunscreen is advised.
